## Summary

A one-sentence description of the feature.

## Problem It Solves

Describe the current limitation or gap this feature addresses. What can you not do today, or what is painful to do?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the behavior you would like. Include proposed flag names, output format changes, or API surface changes if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered

List any alternative approaches you considered and why you prefer the proposed solution.

## Additional Context

Screenshots, links, or related issues that provide useful background.
